title: The Effects of Surgery for Painful External Snapping Hip
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the pain-relieving effects of surgery for painful external snapping hip.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing surgery for painful external snapping hip
* 18 years or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to comply with the protocol (e.g. due to dementia)
study_population: All patients undergoing surgery for painful external snapping hip in The North Denmark Region between 2008-2013 with at least 1 year follow-up time.
